label: Acquire research source
description: Download and prepare one selected public PDF or HTML page so its full content can be read and cited. Search the local library first when acquiring a paper. Use only an exact URL supplied by the user or returned by a source search; never construct or guess alternate URLs. Acquisition is idempotent: matching source URLs, arXiv identifiers (across versions), or exact titles reuse the local document and report already_in_library instead of downloading again. Do not use this for metadata-only inspection or repeatedly retry unavailable sources.

parameter_descriptions.kind: Use paper for a public PDF and web_page for an HTML page.
parameter_descriptions.url: The exact public source URL supplied by the user or returned by a source search; never a guessed URL.
parameter_descriptions.title: A human-readable title when known; otherwise use JSON null, never the string "null".
